title: 罗琳的事  (Confrontation Over Luo Lin)

segments.t: On stage during the semifinal broadcast, singer Xin Huimei suddenly challenges the results of the singing competition. She then storms backstage to confront chief producer Chun Yuqiao directly in the control area. Let us listen to what she says.
淳于总！
就是因为她的声音像你的前女友，你就把人家黑掉了。
你这样做，就是怕跟骆琳两个字牵扯上什么关系吧？
所有人准备，做好应急方案。
阿飞，赶快去。
骆琳这么多年，也是因为你吗？
现场的所有的朋友们，现在我们正式进入淘汰阶段。
我现在知道了，我为什么来了为什么逃走了。
按照你们这些制作人的惯例，我刚才讲的那些真话一定会被剪掉吧。
可惜你那些黑历史，没法剪掉。
Let us break down their argument. Xin Huimei goes right for the throat with an accusation.
淳于总！
'Director Chun!' She calls him "zong", meaning 'director', setting a cold tone.
就是因为她的声音像你的前女友，你就把人家黑掉了。
'Just because her voice resembles your ex-girlfriend, you sabotaged her.' She uses "jiushi yinwei" to mean 'just because', followed by "qian nvyu" for 'ex-girlfriend'.
你这样做，就是怕跟骆琳两个字牵扯上什么关系吧？
'You are acting like this just because you are afraid of being associated with the name Luo Lin, right?' The word "pa" means 'to be afraid'. She ends with "ba" to frame her accusation as a question.
所有人准备，做好应急方案。
'Everyone get ready, prepare emergency protocols.' Chun Yuqiao ignores her completely. He tells the crew to "zhunbei", or 'get ready'.
阿飞，赶快去。
'A Fei, go quickly.' Wen Simo tells him to go "gankuai", meaning 'quickly', to manage the chaos.
骆琳这么多年，也是因为你吗？
'Has Luo Lin suffered all these years because of you too?' She continues her attack, demanding to know if his past actions caused "Luo Lin" to suffer.
现场的所有的朋友们，现在我们正式进入淘汰阶段。
'All our friends in the audience, we are now officially entering the elimination phase.' Host Wen Simo smoothly distracts the audience with "xianzai", meaning 'now'.
我现在知道了，我为什么来了为什么逃走了。
'Now I understand, why I came and why I left.' She realizes she was wrong to "lai", meaning 'come', to his show.
按照你们这些制作人的惯例，我刚才讲的那些真话一定会被剪掉吧。

'Following the usual practice of you producers, the truth I just spoke will definitely be cut, right?' She mocks the "guanli" or 'usual practice' of the industry, knowing they will try to hide the incident.
可惜你那些黑历史，没法剪掉。
'It is a pity that your dark history cannot be cut out.' She leaves him with a final warning. "kexi" means 'it is a pity'. Let us listen to the whole confrontation again.
淳于总！
就是因为她的声音像你的前女友，你就把人家黑掉了。
你这样做，就是怕跟骆琳两个字牵扯上什么关系吧？
所有人准备，做好应急方案。
阿飞，赶快去。
骆琳这么多年，也是因为你吗？
现场的所有的朋友们，现在我们正式进入淘汰阶段。
我现在知道了，我为什么来了为什么逃走了。
按照你们这些制作人的惯例，我刚才讲的那些真话一定会被剪掉吧。
可惜你那些黑历史，没法剪掉。

Xin Huimei has made her point, leaving Chun Yuqiao to deal with the fallout. You learned how to say "jiushi yinwei" for "just because", the word for "ex-girlfriend", and how to talk about being afraid. See you next time!
下次见！
